attrs.content:
Grants Unlock Your Accessible Home
We Handle the Rest.
Essential VA Housing Grants
Access funding tailored for service-connected disabilities—up to lifetime maximums for ramps, lifts, bathroom remodels, and more.
HISA Grant
Up to $6,800 lifetime (service-connected) or $2,000 for others. Covers medically justified modifications like grab bars, widened doors, and ramps.
Home Improvements and Structural Alterations Grant for service-connected disabilities or 50%+ rating.
SAH Grant
Up to $121,812 (FY2026 est.) for severe disabilities (e.g., loss of limbs, blindness). Funds new builds, major adaptations, or mortgage reductions.
Specially Adapted Housing Grant for veterans with qualifying severe service-connected disabilities.
SHA Grant
Up to $25,350 (FY2026) for targeted changes like ramps or accessible kitchens. Ideal for existing homes.
Special Housing Adaptation Grant for veterans needing modifications to their current residence.
Temporary Residence Adaptation (TRA) adds up to $50,961 (SAH-eligible) or $9,100 (SHA) for temporary living situations while you transition to permanent housing.
Certified Accessibility Professionals for Veterans
Our team holds the highest industry certifications to ensure your VA-funded home modifications are installed safely, correctly, and to code—honoring your service with professional expertise.
Assistive Technology Professional (ATP)
Certified expertise in mobility equipment assessment and implementation for veterans with service-connected disabilities.
Executive Certificate in Home Modification (ECHM)
Advanced training in comprehensive home modifications to maximize independence and safety for veterans at home.
Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS)
Specialized design and installation expertise for creating accessible living spaces that adapt to changing needs.
Certified Living In Place Professional (CLIPP)
Comprehensive knowledge in modifications that enable veterans to live independently and safely in their own homes.
Certified Environmental Access Consultant (C.E.A.C.)
Expert assessment and consultation on environmental accessibility standards and VA compliance requirements.
Trusted Veteran Resources
Connect with experts for guidance, applications (VA Form 26-4555), and support throughout your grant journey.
